about: A field left to itself concentrates where it already is and keeps its deserts: under attachment the horizon falls slowly and does not close, in sixty epochs and in either draw.
The same budget spent each epoch where reach is greatest drives the horizon to zero in four epochs.
The machine that does it holds nothing and asserts nothing: it reads the field as it stands, answers which two islands to bridge, and is a cell of the field it weaves.

cases.name: twenty-four cells, three origins an epoch, sixty epochs
